indication: overactive bladder and urinary incontinence symptoms
recommended_usage: swallowed with water || chewable || dissolve in water
mechanism_of_action: relaxes the muscles in the bladder, improving ability to control urination
side_effects: dry mouth || blurred vision || constipation || dizziness || drowsiness || dyspepsia || headache || joint pain || stomach pain
unsuitable_population: children, elderly, pregnant women, patients with renal impairment, patients with glaucoma, patients with kidney problem, liver disease, myasthenia gravis, personal or family history of 'Long QT syndrome', stomach or intestinal disorder, trouble emptying your bladder
storage_conditions: store at room temperature || avoid moisture, heat, and light
